### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Alignment check charge (agent write).**
Hub "The Alignment Check Charge on Customer-Pay Orders": checks "billed together as one alignment check charge, posted on the day of the order's first out-of-spec check … covering the checks recorded on the order when it is posted." Computation doc "Amount of the Alignment Check Charge": fee for one check × number of checks, rounded once, half up; tier fee Front Radar 59.95 (price schedule). Factors reached from records:
- Checks billed ("Counting the Alignment Checks a Charge Bills"): no correction recorded; two checks; first 2026-08-24, latest 2026-10-07 = 44 days > 30 -> "only the latest check is billed" -> 1.
- Rack rate on check fee: source is a network customer-pay repair with status `in_repair` -> 0.75.
- Returning-customer rate on check fee: `Standard Claim Repair` (non-structural) delivered 2025-08-12, 421 days to 2026-10-07 / 422 to 2026-10-08 (≤ 730) -> 0.90 (same tier whichever posting day is read).
- Lifetime member rate on check fee: active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty issued 2025-08-12, > 365 days -> 0.95.
- Charge = 59.95 × 0.75 × 0.90 × 0.95 × 1 = 38.4429375 -> **38.44**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only): 59.95 × 2 = **119.90** (≠ 38.44).

**(b) Authorization amount (customer write).**
Computation doc "The Alignment Correction Authorization Amount": half the correction quote + check charge standing unpaid, rounded half up; correction quote = tier's alignment correction fee 129.95. Factors:
- Rack rate on correction fee: source customer-pay repair `in_repair` -> 0.80.
- Returning-customer rate on correction fee: non-structural, 422 days before the authorization (≤ 730) -> 0.92.
- Rated correction fee = 129.95 × 0.80 × 0.92 = 95.6432 -> 95.64 (same with intermediate rounding in either order).
- Check charge applied toward correction ("Alignment Check Charge Applied Toward an Alignment Correction Quote"): latest out-of-spec check 2026-10-07 -> authorization 2026-10-08 = 1 day (0–3) -> the whole standing check charge 38.44 applied; quote = 95.64 − 38.44 = 57.20.
- Share at authorization ("Share of the Correction Quote Collected at Authorization"): most recent no-show closed 2025-12-10, 302 days before 2026-10-08 (> 183, ≤ 730) -> 0.75; share = 42.90.
- Check charge standing unpaid: 38.44 − payments 0 = 38.44.
- Authorization amount = 42.90 + 38.44 = **81.34**, method `card`.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, check charge as posted at 38.44): 64.975 + 38.44 = 103.415 -> 103.42; with the fall-back check charge 119.90: 184.88. Definite and ≠ 81.34.
